result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=with, B=without): Both pages are self-contained and use a system sans with a monospaced face for IDs. A also sets the ETA times and dock doors in monospace, so the time column lines up and is easier to compare. A's status pills are also clearer, with distinct colors and bold uppercase labels. In B, Received and Unloading share the same green and Arrived and Scheduled share the same grey, its ETAs are in the proportional sans, and its status text is smaller and harder to read from across a room. | pass 2 (A=without, B=with): Both pages use a system sans with a monospace face for codes, and they look very similar overall. B sets ETA times in monospace with the time above the day label, so times are easier to scan and line up. Its status pills also all have different colours, while A uses the same grey for Arrived and Scheduled. A sets ETAs in the sans with the day label above the time, which makes the times a little harder to compare down the column.
